Film Roll Frame Budget

With only a fixed number of frames left on the roll, hold a few back for ad-hoc scenes, then allocate the rest by minimum and priority. The result lists the planned frames and the unmet target for each scene.

Frames available

Remaining frames is the actual count left on the roll (0–200); frames held for ad-hoc scenes defaults to 0 and cannot exceed the remaining frames.

Scenes

Up to 16 scenes. Short names are 1–24 characters and must be unique; each row takes a minimum and a target (0–200, target not below minimum), and a priority: 3 is top priority, 2 standard, 1 optional.

The sample is fixed dummy data (24 frames remaining, 4 held) showing priority round-robin; press “Allocate remaining frames” to compute it.
